bio: José A. Gómez-Ibáñez is the Derek C. Bok Research Professor of Urban Planning and Public Policy at Harvard University, where he holds a joint appointment at the Graduate School of Design and the John F. Kennedy School of Government. He has taught courses in economics, infrastructure and transportation policy in both schools. Professor Gómez-Ibáñez research interests are in transportation, infrastructure, and economic development, and he has authored or edited a half dozen books including:
